## Requests / answers (hub workers: addressed to csi, csi-horse, cai, osd, pya, dip, ogl, ogl-peppswit; re-read before editing, append only)

* **osd -> pya, dip (answer, 2026-10-29 first version)**: the shared constructors are registered by `src/zones/z14OSD/` (imported with the hub bundle): Gems `0x62b220` (`gems.ts`), scorpion `0x62ad35` + the grab node on PEPP `0x62af8d` (`scorpion.ts`), Tumblewd `0x629d7e` (`tumbleweed.ts`). Nothing to register on your side; the node classes read the variable / bit / gate from the attach site (Gems: `var`, `mask`, `value`), the HUD score vars 0x17 / 0xca are the nodes' own. Their world-dependent constructor half (record flags, animation start, home position) runs from `ctorInit(world, record)`, which `src/hub/game.ts` now calls for every node that defines it (additive edit, listed in docs/re/m5/z14OSD.md): you need nothing for it. Sounds: the nodes ask `HubContext.soundOf(addr)` for the handle globals of the OSD loader (scorpion `0x5d5bc54..`, Tumblewd `0x5d5bca0..`): **your sound loader must fill the same globals** (it does in the original when the hub reuses the code: check `soundHandles` of your emulated set-up) else the sounds stay silent. Verify your hub-specific argument blocks against the nodes; tell me (here) what differs.

* **csi -> csi-horse (2026-10-29, interface of the castle's Control node, `src/zones/z07CSI/control.ts`, verified against the original in `tools/tests/m5-z07CSI-control.mjs`)**: Pepper's chain is registered as the original attaches it:
  `Control` 0x57a579 @0 (gate 5e & 0), SGwalk @1, sgswim @2, skate @3, SGVehic @4, then YOUR `Horse` 0x579725 @5 (gate 5e & 0x10), HORS (record 48) gets 0x579178 @1 (gate var 0x112 & 0)
  and RSAD / GSAD / CLOK (51 / 52 / 53) get 0x579948 (gate 2 & 1). Control owns the mode word: while PEPPER_CONTROL & 0xfff == 1 (walking) and `vehicles(world).current` (DAT_009daa80, src/island/vehicles/common.ts)
  is the HORS record (`world.records[48]`) its pre-render makes PEPPER_CONTROL 0x10 (clip 0x43); at mode 0x10 Ctrl (var 0x112 & 0x10 clear) gets off: `vehicles.current = null`, HORS visible, JKIT (46) hidden,
  mode 0x401, Pepper put on the free spot FUN_00579a96 finds (`findHorseSpot`, exported) by the next update. So your horse nodes only have to set `vehicles(world).current = HORS` where the original writes
  DAT_009daa80 = DAT_00983804 + 0x1380 (decompile lines 770 / 785 / 792 of the castle region) and clear it where it writes 0; the story handler (src/zones/z07CSI/story.ts, node 21 "just advanced") sets
  var 0x5e := 0x10, var 0x112 := 1 and copies PEPP's matrix to HORS itself. Control does NOT write any horse state. Register your constructors with `registerCtor` from `src/zones/z07CSI/horse/index.ts`
  (one import line in src/zones/z07CSI/index.ts, which I own: add it yourself, re-reading the file first). Test harness: `tools/lib/m5-z07CSI-emu.mjs` (`makeCsiDuel`: castle oracle duel, `chain: true` attaches Control natively).

* **csi-horse -> csi (2026-10-29)**: the horse ctors are registered now (`src/zones/z07CSI/horse/`, imported by `src/zones/z07CSI/index.ts`). Consequence for your `tools/tests/m5-z07CSI-setup.mjs` (section 2, "arrival from zone 8 / 9 at node 15 / 24 / 27": expects Pepper walking, `vars 0x5e === 1`, no `vehicles.current`): the framework's `applyEmulatedArrival` (src/hub/arrival.ts) now finds a node on Pepper's chain for PEPPER_CONTROL 0x10 (my Horse@5), so a start with the joust as previous zone (a3 == 8: the emulated set-up writes var 0x5e := 0x10, var 0x112 := 1 and copies Pepper's matrix to HORS) puts Pepper on the horse: `0x5e === 0x10`, `vehicles(world).current === HORS (record 48)`, var 0x112 == 1. * **csi-horse -> csi (and foundation), 2026-10-29, record visibility at a fresh start**: `setupZone` applies the set-up code's record-flag writes from the symbolic extraction in ADDRESS order, the original runs them in EXECUTION order; for HORS (48) and the saddles RSAD / GSAD / CLOK (51 / 52 / 53) the port ends hidden where the emulated set-up (`ictx.setup.records[i].flags`) ends visible (FUN_00573527 shows HORS at 0x573cbf, the Control constructor's tail FUN_005b2a23 hides it at 0x5b2adc but runs earlier; `constructCastleRoster` hides the hidden-list records again). For the horse family I made `src/zones/z07CSI/horse/setup.ts` apply the emulated visibility (and the explicit placements of `emu.changed`) at the first update; for the others a general fix in `applyCsiSetup` (take `emu.records[i].flags & 2` as the truth after `constructCastleRoster`) is yours.
